# 1 Clement Chapter 60 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 60 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_060_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 60

*[The Great Prayer — Part II: Intercession for Rulers and All Humanity]*

**60:1** For you have made manifest the everlasting constitution of the world through the works that you have fashioned. You, LORD, created the earth. You who are faithful throughout all generations, righteous in your judgments, wonderful in strength and splendor, wise in creating and prudent in establishing the things that exist; you who are good in the things that are visible and faithful among those who trust in you — merciful and compassionate; forgive us our iniquities and unrighteous acts, and our transgressions and failings.

**60:2** Reckon not every sin of your servants and handmaidens, but cleanse us with the cleansing of your truth, and guide our steps to walk in holiness of heart, and to do the things that are good and well-pleasing before you and before our rulers.

**60:3** Yes, Lord, let your face shine upon us for good in peace, and let your mighty hand protect us, and let your uplifted arm defend us from every sin. Deliver us from those who hate us unjustly.

**60:4** Give harmony and peace to us and to all who dwell upon the earth, as you gave to our fathers when they called upon you in faith and in truth; that we may be saved, while we render obedience to your omnipotent and all-excellent name, and to our rulers and governors upon the earth.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness. Chapter 60 continues the Great Prayer (chs. 59–61).*
